concepts.name: Paging
concepts.description: Division of virtual memory into fixed-size pages.
concepts.evidence: Paging divides virtual address space into fixed-size pages.

concepts.name: Page table
concepts.description: Maps virtual pages to physical frames.
concepts.evidence: A page table maps virtual pages to physical frames.

concepts.name: Page fault
concepts.description: Occurs when a requested page is absent from physical memory.
concepts.evidence: A page fault occurs when a requested page is not currently present in physical memory.
